cases.sentence: Ты возведешь скинию шатер собрания в первый день первого ___.
cases.translation: You shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting on the first day of the first month.
cases.explain: In time expressions, the genitive case is used after ordinals like 'первого' (first).

cases.sentence: Поставь в ней ковчег свидетельства и закрой его ___.
cases.translation: Put the ark of the covenant in it and cover it with a veil.
cases.explain: The transitive verb закрой (cover) governs the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Поставь умывальник между шатром собрания и жертвенником и налей в него ___.
cases.translation: Set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it.
cases.explain: The transitive verb налей (pour) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Возьми масло для помазания и помажь скинию и все, что в ___.
cases.translation: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with a pronoun takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Поставь жертвенник для всесожжения перед входом в шатер собрания рядом со входом к ___.
cases.translation: Set the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) always governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он поставил стол в шатре собрания на северной его стороне за ___.
cases.translation: He set the table in the Tent of Meeting on its north side, behind the veil.
cases.explain: The preposition за (behind) takes the instrumental case for location.

cases.sentence: Облако покрыло шатер собрания, и слава Господа наполнило ___.
cases.translation: The cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
cases.explain: The transitive verb наполнило (filled) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Облако Господа было над Скинией днем, а ночью в этом облаке горел огонь на глазах у всего дома ___.
cases.translation: The cloud of the Lord was over the tabernacle by day, and fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'house of' uses the genitive case.

reading.ru: Ты возведешь скинию шатер собрания в первый день первого месяца.
reading.question: When was the tabernacle to be set up according to God's command?
options: On the first day of the seventh month
On the first day of the first month
On the first day of the twelfth month
On the fortieth day of the first month
reading.correct: On the first day of the first month
reading.explain: The text states the tabernacle would be raised up on the first day of the first month.

reading.ru: Поставь в ней ковчег свидетельства и закрой его завесой.
reading.question: What was to be put in the tabernacle and how was it to be protected?
options: The table and lamp stand together
The ark of the covenant covered with a veil
The altar and the basin with water
reading.correct: The ark of the covenant covered with a veil
reading.explain: The instruction explicitly states to put the ark of the covenant in it and cover it with a veil.

reading.ru: Приведи Аарона и его сыновей ко входу в шатер собрания и омой их водой.
reading.question: What was to be done with Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting?
options: They were to present offerings to God
They were to be brought there and washed with water
They were to put on their sacred garments
They were to anoint the altar
reading.correct: They were to be brought there and washed with water
reading.explain: The text states Aaron and his sons were to be brought to the entrance and washed with water.

reading.ru: Он поставил светильник в шатре собрания напротив стола на южной стороне скинии и засветил перед Господом лампады.
reading.question: Where was the lampstand placed in the Tent of Meeting?
options: On the north side behind the veil
Opposite the table on the south side
At the entrance to the tabernacle
In front of the golden altar
reading.correct: Opposite the table on the south side
reading.explain: The verse states the lampstand was placed opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle.

reading.ru: Моисей, Аарон и его сыновья мыли в нем руки и ноги.
reading.question: What did Moses, Aaron, and his sons wash in the basin?
options: The stones and boards of the tabernacle
reading.explain: The text explicitly states they washed their hands and their feet in the basin.

reading.ru: Облако покрыло шатер собрания, и слава Господа наполнило скинию.
reading.question: What happened after the tabernacle was completely set up?
options: The people began to offer sacrifices
The priests entered and began their service immediately
The cloud covered the Tent of Meeting and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle
The altar was anointed with oil by Moses
reading.correct: The cloud covered the Tent of Meeting and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle
reading.explain: The text states that the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
